propositions: Current command syntax is split across multiple parsers and manually maintained help files, causing documentation-implementation drift
Single-source argparse factories must be established as the authoritative grammar definition for all command families
Generated package help and overview must be byte-deterministic and derived exclusively from factory definitions
Parser migrations must maintain argv-parity (accepted/rejected arguments, diagnostics, exit codes) between old imperative handlers and new factory-based ones
Top-level routing must serve generated help artifacts before operation/config/store/handler boundaries while preserving the compatibility execution ladder
Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, contradictory policies, and missing parser references without requiring full handler imports at startup
